reels.recommendation_summary: Recommends Canyon Overlook Trail as one of Zion's best views at the end of a 1-mile trail: biggest payoff for least effort in Zion, ~160 ft gain, 1-2 hours, just east of the Zion-Mount Carmel Tunnel, incredible at sunrise or sunset, views over Pine Creek Canyon. This place was already on the map from the @amorywild sunrise reel, so it was added as a second source on that pin instead of a duplicate pin.
reels.theme: Best short hike / best view in Zion
reels.title: Canyon Overlook Trail — One of Zion's Best Views
